sentences.l2: 庭の片隅に、子供のための遊び小屋を建てる計画が持ち上がった。
sentences.l1: A plan to build a playhouse for the children in a corner of the garden came up.

sentences.l2: 単なる物置きではなく、創造性を刺激する空間にしたいと考えたのだ。
sentences.l1: I thought I wanted to make it a space that stimulates creativity, not just a storage shed.

sentences.l2: そこで、デザインを決める際、子供が自由に描いた絵を参考にすることにした。
sentences.l1: So, when deciding on the design, I decided to use a picture the child had drawn freely as a reference.

sentences.l2: 現実的な設計図とは異なるが、その絵には彼が求める理想の世界が詰まっている。
sentences.l1: It is different from a realistic blueprint, but that picture is full of the ideal world he wants.

sentences.l2: 最終的に、その雰囲気を取り入れた、木漏れ日が差し込む開放的な小屋が完成し、家族の新たな憩いの場となった。
sentences.l1: In the end, an open playhouse that took in that atmosphere, with sunlight filtering through the trees, was completed and became a new place of rest for the family.
